meta.name: audit-northstar
meta.description: Audits easyskillz code changes against North Star principles for design integrity and correctness.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码变更是否符合设计原则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保代码变更不偏离既定的设计原则。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code changes against design principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure code changes adhere to design principles.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动审查 easyskillz 项目的代码变更（如差异、新文件、暂存更改或 PR），对照五个核心设计原则给出每条原则的通过/失败结论，并列出具体违规位置和修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求审查、检查、QA 或审计 easyskillz 代码变更的正确性或设计完整性时触发。也适用于准备 PR 或分支时希望获得设计合规性第二意见的场景。

say.text: 审计我最近的代码变更。
say.note: 自动检测暂存或未暂存的更改并生成报告。

say.text: 在合并前审查这个 PR。
say.note: 自动检测 PR 对应的差异并审计所有五个原则。

say.text: 检查这个新功能是否遵守设计原则。
say.note: 自动分析变更并报告违规。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude automatically audits easyskillz code changes (diffs, new files, staged changes, or PRs) against five North Star design principles, returning a PASS/FAIL verdict per principle with specific file:line violations and actionable fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to review, check, QA, or audit easyskillz changes for correctness or design integrity. Also triggered when preparing a PR or branch and wanting a second opinion on design compliance.

say_en.note: Auto-detects staged or unstaged changes and generates a report.

say_en.text: Review this PR before I merge.
say_en.note: Auto-detects the PR diff and audits all five principles.

say_en.text: Check if this new feature respects our design principles.
